Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest

Class FillBucketEventGameTests

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest.FillBucketEventGameTests
public final class FillBucketEventGameTests extends Object
Coverage for the player world-use FillBucketEvent contract: fires exactly once per supported world/cauldron interaction, at the position that will actually be mutated, with cancellation and ALLOW handled honestly. Capability transactions and native powder-block output do not post it. See ForgeBucketOperations.beforeWorldBucketUse.
